The '''Filly townspeople''' are wastelanders at [[Filly]] {{In|FOTV}}. 

==Background==
These people are seen at the town of Filly near the [[Los Angeles|Boneyard]] in [[New California]]. They come from various groups and backgrounds; some are inhabitants of the town, while others are visitors from around the region. These people include local [[Filly vendor|vendors]], [[Scavenger (TV series)|scavengers]], and even raiders.

One known townsperson is the father of Sheriff [[Troy (TV series)|Troy]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Target]]===
Entering the outskirts of Filly, [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] passes by several Filly townspeople, two of whom she tries to introduce herself to but is coldly ignored by them. She then circumnavigates through the crowd of people and, after interacting with a [[Filly vendor]], enters the downtown area of Filly.

In the downtown area, Lucy briefly watches as the Filly townspeople assume their daily lives in the town, one of whom was pulling a [[Brahmin (TV series)|Brahmin]].

Entering Filly, [[Siggi Wilzig|Wilzig]] and his [[CX404|Dog companion]] passed by various Filly townspeople. Right after talking with Lucy and [[Ma June]], [[the Ghoul]] calls out Wilzig as various Filly townspeople are alerted by the Ghoul's presence.

Moments after, Ma June puts a thousand [[bottle cap]]s bounty on the Ghoul's head after he used his [[Dom Pedro (TV series weapon)|revolver]] to blow off Wilzig's leg. Several of the townspeople try and collect the bounty only to die by the Ghoul using his revolver against them.

As Lucy and Wilzig exit the downtown area of Filly, most of the townspeople are seen either fleeing or being consoled by the vendors. [[Maximus]] in a [[T-60 power armor|powerarmor]] would crash it by the Filly latrines where a townsperson was using one.

===[[The Head]]===
While Maximus performs diagnostics on his power armor, some townspeople are seen in the distance minding their own business. He then passes by more townspeople entering and walking through the downtown area, where he spoke to [[Jamila]] to repair a broken part of his power armor.

Just as Maximus reinstalls the repaired part, townspeople are seen walking around a [[Brotherhood of Steel]] [[Vertibird]] flies into the downtown area. There, the Vertibird drops off [[Thaddeus]] in the center of town, where more townspeople roam about, much to Maximus' chagrin. 

===[[The Trap]]===
Filly is mentioned when the Ghoul is taken to be interrogated by the president of the [[Govermint]], [[Sorrel Booker]], by Sheriffs [[Troy]] and [[Rex]]. The Ghoul confesses that, including shooting up the [[Super Duper Mart (TV series)|Super Duper Mart]], he shot up Filly and killed roughly nine or ten people there. Troy then comments that his father lived in Filly, and the Ghoul comments that he doesn't any longer, unless he's a "coward." Troy aims the confiscated [[Mare's Leg (TV series)|Mare's Leg]], which he took from the Ghoul, at him and proclaims that his father isn't a coward.

===[[The Beginning]]===
Eventually, the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] usurp Filly, and it's confirmed by a [[Vertibird pilot (TV series)|Vertibird pilot]] who mentions that the locals "put up a fight" but were suppressed with force by the Brotherhood.

==Appearances==
Filly townspeople appear {{In|FOTV}}, and are mentioned in "[[The Trap]]" and "[[The Beginning]]."
